summary: The closed-result intake, CPU recount and conditional three-path weight retention tools are correct after the primary-tie promotion inconsistency was fixed. No current-run terminal result or cleanup eligibility is inferred.

provenance.review_context: follow-up in the same existing reviewer context

resolved_findings.original_issue: The inherited ranking (hits50,hits25,tie-parent) allowed old4509 deletion when Acc@.50 tied but .25 improved, contrary to the registered strict Acc@.50 promotion rule.
resolved_findings.resolution: Executor changed ranking to (hits50,tie-parent,hits25) and added the same strict-primary-improvement predicate immediately before the deletion phase. Both generators and source bindings were synchronized.

checks.evidence: collect_formal_authorized.py is byte-identical to the completed predecessor. It requires a closed observer/controller with a recorded exit before intake. It collects only json/jsonl/log/exit/py/md files, never pth/tmp weights. A failed closed run can be collected for diagnosis, but the downstream analyzer and cleanup require exit0. There is no neural execution, weight download or negative-weight archive in the collector.

analyze_closed_formal.py:71 reads pvground_query_supported_geometry_20261005/complete/query_supported/formal, the actual retained4509 parent. Its rows SHA matches the actual receipt. Read-only local recount of the existing historical9508 rows yields hits25=5614, hits50=4509, Acc25=59.045014724442574%, Acc50=47.423222549432055%, with0 CPU threshold changes. This is prior-parent evidence, not a result for the currently running arms.

geometry_result_metrics.py is byte-identical to the predecessor. It preserves strict IoU>threshold, hits/row-count*100 accuracy, mean Mask IoU*100, root-GT CPU Box IoU threshold checks, same-query coarse/final repairs/damages, and paired identity checks for row/scan/target/root/point SHA. paired(parent,parent) gives zero repairs/damages/net/query changes at both thresholds. Masks and candidate availability remain scalar recounts; no raw-mask replay is claimed.

Analyzer and cleanup now use control/member_target. Both specs and all training log entries must have extra_geometry_weight1; target modes are native_gt/member_gt. Analyzer requires3723 log steps,29778 unique rows, equal arm order, B8/effectiveB8/accumulation1/tail2, fresh optimizer and frozen parent/zeroR. Cleanup payload checks parent7446, current3723 and total11169, plus native9508 formal receipts. Runner/helper/controller/specs and the registered plan were not changed by the correction.

The unchanged producer evaluates last/bbs against native dataset GT after disabling both augment flags, and verifies hit counts against the native evaluator. Analyzer requires9508 ordered formal rows, initial/terminal6887 rows, pass receipts, one native-head call and no diagnostic replay. Per-row paired comparisons preserve native GT and point identity. New auxiliary member targets do not become evaluation GT.

The analyzer requires actual closed complete exit0 intake with protected parents, and validates receipt/log/row bytes before any summary. The authorized cleanup wrapper requires closed observer/controller exit0, ACTUAL_CLOSED_ROWS_ANALYZED with exact training order, actual terminal audit PASS/WARN with no blockers, TERMINAL_REVIEW_CALL.result_received, and this SOURCE_ONLY source verdict plus existing file bindings before SSH. The existing joint-target conflict guard preserves candidates if the metric winner would discard the sole dual-threshold success. This source follow-up does not satisfy or replace the future terminal-result audit.

Analyzer line91 now ranks (hits50, tie-parent, hits25). retain_metric_best.py checks winner==protected_geometry_parent OR winner.hits50>parent.hits50 before any unlink. Therefore a primary tie retains4509 even if a new arm has better.25. Among new arms strictly above the parent, .25 remains the tie-breaker. Actual-source expression checks cover primary tie/secondary improvement, strict primary improvement, and a new-arm tie above the parent; these are policy examples, not observed new results.

Before any unlink, remote cleanup checks both new checkpoint bytes against fit/formal_restore receipts, native9508 metrics against the decision,3723 optimizer steps,29778 unique rows, head-only10-state key set and shapes equal to the retained parent,456102 total elements, distribution/whole_range/1/7 metadata, official/G/source/parent identities, extra weight1 and correct target mode. The producer saves full replacement values for all10 geometry tensors. The existing factory directly loads those10 values after officialPV+originalG and does not recursively load old4509 lineage. A verified promoted complete head is therefore reconstructible without deleting any other parent component.

Root resolves exactly to /root/autodl-tmp/pvground_auxiliary_target_20261005. The old parent resolves exactly to /root/autodl-tmp/pvground_query_supported_geometry_20261005/query_supported/terminal.pth and its known SHA is checked. The only deletion candidates are that path plus new control/terminal.pth and member_target/terminal.pth; each nonwinner is unlinked only after all checks. No recursive deletion, officialPV/G/V99 path, local checkpoint copy or negative-weight archive is present. The script never writes weight files.

All seven tools parse. Collector, metrics helper and authorized retention wrapper remain byte-identical to predecessor. Both preparation scripts reproduce their current analyzer/retention outputs exactly using only in-memory deterministic text derivation. Updated CLOSED_RESULT_TOOLS/RETENTION_TOOLS digests match current files. The two changed selection/deletion conditions are the minimal correction of the registered primary-promotion rule.

actual_source_policy_cases.primary_tie_secondary_improves: parent retained; forced new-winner deletion predicate rejected

limitations: Current training is still active according to the task context. The new pair has no actual terminal intake/summary/audit here; this review is a source check only.
The historical parent-only CPU recount and synthetic policy examples are not new control/member_target results.
Future cleanup must still pass the actual closed-result integrity review and every live on-server receipt/header/path check. No checkpoint was opened by this reviewer.
